Your wardrobe

Who are you dressing?

We’ll show the modes and clothes that fit. You can change this any time in Profile.

How it works

  1. 1
    Take a photoWe create your body outline.
  2. 2
    Choose a modeSelect which area you want to try.
  3. 3
    Point at clothesThe camera shows real clothes on you!

In this preview your wardrobe stands in for the live camera: open it from the garment button at the bottom left of step 3, pick clothes, and drag or pinch them to adjust.
